title: Skin Chromophore
description: Quantitative skin colorimetry (CIE L*a*b*, ITA° for b* > 1, CIEDE2000) and uncalibrated fixed-basis RGB optical-density chromophore proxies (RGB EI/MI and fixed-basis melanin/hemoglobin OD proxies inspired by Tsumura et al. 1999) for dermatology photography and dermoscopy.

analyze.title: Analyze skin chromophores
analyze.description: Compute CIE L*a*b*, Individual Typology Angle (ITA°, restricted to b* > 1), uncalibrated RGB Erythema/Melanin Index proxies (EI, MI), fixed-basis melanin and hemoglobin optical-density proxy maps (not per-image ICA or calibrated spectrophotometry), and Target vs Perilesional Reference colorimetry with CIEDE2000.

image.description: One 2D dermatology or dermoscopy image (JPEG or PNG)

whiteBalance.description: Apply Shades of Gray (p=6) linear-RGB white-balance normalization before colorimetry

maskVignette.description: Exclude dark dermoscope vignette borders via edge-seeded peripheral flood-fill (luminance < 22); transparent pixels (alpha < 128) are always excluded

roiMode.description: Automatic lesion ROI by Otsu Lab contrast against the perilesional ring (auto), or fixed central 25% disk (central)
